_comment: Behavioral kept-red proof for #1484. The real scanDrawerSurfaces enumerates its fixture directory, and the two named assertions require the unfixed ENOENT to propagate through the beforeStat/pre-stat and beforeReadSourceFile/post-stat windows. Corrected code fails both assertions with AssertionError. After both windows were exercised, no surviving mutation was found: (1) drawer isEnoent => false makes both named drawer tests pass; (2) drawer stat-catch classification changed from isEnoent(error) to false makes the pre-stat test pass; (3) drawer read-catch classification changed from isEnoent(error) to false makes the post-stat test pass; (4) translation isEnoent => false makes the companion named translation test pass.

expectedRed.testName: drawer scanner propagates the unfixed pre-stat ENOENT race
expectedRed.why: The exact reproducing path is scanDrawerSurfaces → fixture enumeration → beforeStat deletion of DRAWER_RACE_PROOF_FIXTURE.filePath → real stat. The corrected ENOENT recovery makes the assertion fail; changing the drawer isEnoent classifier or the drawer stat catch to false makes this named assertion pass, so the paired runner detects either restored pre-stat bug.

expectedRed.testName: drawer scanner propagates the unfixed post-stat ENOENT race
expectedRed.why: The exact reproducing path is scanDrawerSurfaces → fixture enumeration → successful real stat → beforeReadSourceFile deletion of DRAWER_RACE_PROOF_FIXTURE.filePath → real readFileSync. The corrected ENOENT recovery makes the assertion fail; changing the drawer isEnoent classifier or the drawer read catch to false makes this named assertion pass, so the paired runner detects either restored post-stat bug.
